BrochureContent.Content:
SUBSTANTIAL 5 BEDROOM RESIDENCE OF CHARM AND CHARACTER ON MATURE SECLUDED GARDENS

A bungalow residence with rear two storey extension on secluded private grounds extending to 0.69 acres sm. A charming residence with a myriad of attractive features on mature secluded grounds, short walk from town.

Property is ideal for a variety of residential uses, with spacious grounds allowing for further development potential.

Sympathetically extended over the years, the property now offers spacious and versatile family accommodation comprising five bedrooms, four bathrooms, a guest WC, and a selection of expansive living areas. A stylish garden sunroom overlooks the south-facing patio, creating an ideal space for relaxing or entertaining.

The property has also benefited from sympathetic upgrades in recent years, including a high-efficiency condenser oil-fired boiler and premium Senator uPVC sliding sash windows, carefully selected to preserve the character of the original faade while improving comfort and energy efficiency.

Outside, the property continues to impress with extensive lawns, mature gardens, established trees and planting, a detached workshop and stables, generous yard, paddock, raised vegetable beds and ample parking, offering an exceptional lifestyle opportunity rarely found within a central town setting.

This represents a rare opportunity to acquire a truly special family home with exceptional long-term potencial.
